column1: Q24_5. I feel like most people don’t understand me as a person
Q17. How often have you experienced the following in the last twelve months?
Q17_1. Felt lonely or disconnected from others
Q17_3. Felt like you are a part of the country
Q17_4. Had someone to turn to for emotional support
Q17_5. Wanted more family or friends to connect with
Q17_6. Felt irrelevant in the world
Q17_7. Felt like you can’t be your true self with others
Q17_8. Been part of a meaningful group or community
Q17_9. Spent time alone with few social interactions
Q24_6. I wish I had more people I could talk to and who truly understand me
Q18B. Thinking of those you communicate with most often outside of work or school responsibilities, would you say…
They are friends but I wouldn't consider them close friends
I do not have social interactions outside of work or school responsibilities
Q18C. Outside of work and school responsibilities, how often do you use the following ways to interact socially?
Q18C_1. In person (face-to-face with friends, family, or acquaintances)
Q18C_2. Phone or video calls, texts, or messaging apps (WhatsApp, iMessage)
Q18C_3. Social media platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Twitter/X, Snapchat)
Q18C_4. Gaming platforms or gaming communities (Twitch, Xbox Live, PlayStation networks, etc)
Q18C_5. Forums or online communities (Reddit, Quora, hobby-specific forums)
Q18C_6. Group communication apps or collaboration platforms (Discord, Slack, Teams)

Q21. There has been an increase of content creators and influencers on podcasts and social media platforms providing advice or sharing information around various topics. Do you regularly follow any content creators or podcasts that discuss the following topics? (Select all that apply.)
Pop culture, such as movies, music, TV shows
Lifestyle, such as travel, day-in-my-life, outfit videos
Life skills and how-to instructions, such as how to write a resume or unclog a drain
Self-help such as overcoming struggles and stepping out of comfort zones
I do not follow any content creators or influencers
